title: "read in data"
format: html
editor: visual
---



```{r}
rm(list = ls(all = TRUE))

# library(broom)
library(data.table)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)

source("R/utils.R")
# library(tidyverse)

# library(extrafont)
# library(ggsegGlasser)
# library(ggseg)

# source("R/plotting.R")
# source("R/rainclouds.R")

setwd("data/")

# read in data ------------------
glasser <- fread("glasser360NodeNames.txt", header = FALSE)
yeo <- fread("yeo_in_glasser.txt")
group <- fread("group.txt", header = FALSE)
age <- fread("age.txt", header = FALSE)
sex <- fread("sex.txt", header = FALSE)

gradient1 <- load_gradient("gradient1.txt", "gradient_1") 
gradient2 <- load_gradient("gradient2.txt", "gradient_2") 
gradient3 <- load_gradient("gradient3.txt", "gradient_3")

demo <- cbind(group, age, sex, gradient1$subject)
setnames(demo, old = colnames(demo)[1], new = "group")
setnames(demo, old = colnames(demo)[2], new = "age")
setnames(demo, old = colnames(demo)[3], new = "sex")
setnames(demo, old = colnames(demo)[4], new = "subject")
demo$sex <- as.factor(demo$sex)

all <- rbind(gradient1, gradient2, gradient3)
setDT(all)

dt_long <- melt(all, id.vars = c("subject", "group", "gradient", "age", "sex"),
                variable.name = "roi",
                value.name = "gradient_score")

dt_long <- dt_long[, hemi := sapply(str_split(roi, "_"), `[`, 1)]
dt_long[hemi == "Left", hemi := "left"]
dt_long[hemi == "Right", hemi := "right"]
dt_long <- dt_long[, region := sapply(str_split(roi, "_"), `[`, 2)]
dt_long <- dt_long[, roi := NULL]

demographics <- unique(dt_long[, c("subject", "age", "sex", "group")])

# add yeo network info
nsubs <- length(unique(dt_long$subject))
ngrad <- length(unique(dt_long$gradient))
nrois <- length(unique(dt_long$region))
dt_long <- dt_long[, yeo := rep(yeo$V1, each = nsubs * ngrad)]
dt_long$yeo <- as.factor(dt_long$yeo)
dt_long[yeo == "1", yeo := "VIS"]
dt_long[yeo == "2", yeo := "SMN"]
dt_long[yeo == "3", yeo := "DAN"]
dt_long[yeo == "4", yeo := "VAN"]
dt_long[yeo == "5", yeo := "LIN"]
dt_long[yeo == "6", yeo := "FPN"]
dt_long[yeo == "7", yeo := "DMN"]

# add visaul stream info
evc_regions <- c("V1", "V2", "V3", "V4")
dorsal_regions <- c("V3A", "V3B", "V6", "V6A", "V7", "IPS1")
ventral_regions <- c("V8", "VVC", "PIT", "FFC", "VMV1", "VMV2", "VMV3", "PHA1",
                     "PHA2", "PHA3", "PreS", "ProS", "DVT")
lateral_occ <- c("V3CD", "LO1", "LO2", "LO3", "V4t", "FST", "MT", "MST", "PH")

dt_long[region %in% evc_regions, stream := "evc"]
dt_long[region %in% dorsal_regions, stream := "dorsal"]
dt_long[region %in% ventral_regions, stream := "ventral"]
dt_long[region %in% lateral_occ, stream := "lateral"]

# normalize scores
dt_long[, gradient_score := (gradient_score - mean(gradient_score, na.rm = TRUE)) / sd(gradient_score, na.rm = TRUE),
        by = .(gradient)]

dt_yeo <- dt_long %>%
  expand(nesting(region, yeo))

saveRDS(dt_long, "gradients_df.RDS")

```
